create_console_writer: create a ConsoleWriter instance to log messages to the console using rich.print by default
use_info_method: use the info method of ConsoleWriter to print informational messages to the console
use_warning_method: use the warning method of ConsoleWriter to print warning messages to the console
use_error_method: use the error method of ConsoleWriter to print error messages to the console
use_exception_method: use the exception method of ConsoleWriter to print an error message and the current traceback
